blue_noise.basis: VolumetricCloud.usf starts each view ray at TMin + BlueNoiseScalar(pixel, StateFrameIndexMod8) x StepT; BlueNoise.cpp GetBlueNoiseGlobalParameters binds a 1x1 black dummy unless both GEngine textures have a resource (an ensure allows that only in a rendering commandlet), and a texture still building answers as a default stand-in: either is one offset for every pixel of every capture, the altitude-slice banding of round 3. aircraft_sharp.motion_blur_rule: off for a still (one instant); on for a clip at the beauty look's 180-degree shutter
aircraft_sharp.velocity_frame: FSceneInterface::StartFrame after the warm-ups and after each delivered beauty frame (the commandlet has no FEngineLoop::Tick to call it): a motion vector spans one delivered frame
aircraft_sharp.still_sub_captures: n/a: a clip is one capture a frame, TSR history carried across frames
aircraft_sharp.motion_blur_time_scale: engine: (1 / MotionBlurTargetFPS) / the family's DeltaRealTime (SceneVisibility.cpp UpdateMotionBlurTimeScale); the commandlet's real delta is not set by the clip rate: unmeasured

accumulation.basis: one capture a frame (measure, or a beauty clip)
accumulation.method: the engine's own temporal accumulation: TSR's jittered history (r.TSR.History.SampleCount caps what it keeps) and Lumen's radiance cache, over repeated captures of one pose; no hand-rolled average, so the tonemapper sees the converged HDR scene
accumulation.labels: rendered once per frame after the last beauty capture, same camera pose, no jitter
accumulation.history_across_frames: TSR keeps its history from the previous delivered frame and reprojects it across the camera move; with one capture a frame (a clip) a moving silhouette can ghost where the label masks, rendered without history, show nothing; unmeasured

machine.basis: DoesPlatformSupportLumenGI / DoesPlatformSupportVirtualShadowMaps / DoesPlatformSupportNanite (RenderUtils.h) and DoesPlatformSupportDistanceFields && DoesProjectSupportDistanceFields (SceneManagement.h) on GMaxRHIShaderPlatform; the cvars reading 1 says nothing about what ran

terrain_material.tangents: per vertex of every georeferenced tile: tangent X the raster's east direction in the surface (dP/du); bitangent +V (south, the row direction) by construction -- the engine's cross(N, T) is +Y, flipped exactly when the georeferencing puts north along +Y
terrain_material.note: the sidecar carries no material block: the composite alone draws, and the material's detail, snow and roughness parameters keep their defaults

cell.component: the look's UVolumetricCloudComponent, taken over (one component draws one cloud field); the look's layer drawn by M_StormCell's Layer term

cell.extinction_unit: the shader's 1/m into the Extinction output at ExtinctionScale 1: whether the engine reads it per metre is WX.4's measurement

curtain.basis: storm_cell.BEAUTY_CURTAIN: the shaft hangs from the lifted base, flares toward the ground, its edge the wall's warped radius (no circle) softened over 75 % of it, thinning toward the ground (the column's water kept); ragged scud in a band under the base and the deck, drifting at half the anvil's drift. Visual only; UNCALIBRATED

shaft.basis: storm_cell.BEAUTY_SHAFT: the curtain noise sampled finer across (vertical streaks), the rim eroded by it (inward only), the density floor opened, the albedo scaled in the shaft (storm_shaft_albedo.hlsl): grey rain, not a luminous cylinder. Evaluated inside the measure shaft's volume only; visual only; UNCALIBRATED

ragged.basis: storm_cell.BEAUTY_RAGGED: the tower's wall warped by one octave of value noise (slope under 1: no folds), its base and the deck's lifted unevenly (upward only), the wall, the base and the deck's base softened over soft_m (no erosion on the deck's base): a soft cloud base, not a slab, and no contour lines at the march's step. Visual only; UNCALIBRATED

beauty_vantage.basis: -quality=beauty: the cell is DRAWN shift_m ahead along the aircraft's track so the clip's track stays clearance_m outside the tower (storm_cell.beauty_vantage_shift_m); the look's deck at the world lane's slab (world_beauty.aircraft_clear_layer); the drawn rain at least rain_share_floor of the shaft's. VISUAL ONLY: the downburst, the wind and every physics number stand; UNCALIBRATED

rain.style_basis: the streaks a camera on the aircraft records over its exposure (Garg & Nayar)
rain.gain_basis: 1: the streak coverage of Garg & Nayar, unexaggerated
rain.determinism: every drop a pure function of (index, seed, run time): deterministic in the step
rain.beauty_readability_basis: -quality=beauty: the drawn drops' opacity x this on top of the gain, so the streaks read on camera (a stated exaggeration, UNCALIBRATED; core/scene/world_beauty.py ATMOSPHERE)

beauty_shape.basis: core/scene/weather_look.py beauty_rain_shape: the drawn count follows the rate, the streak's angular length is capped, the drops near the lens thinned, one streak's coverage capped and faded with range; each streak soft (Gaussian across, tapered), varied in length and brightness by its own hash, and lit at radiance x the scene's light; mean light is NOT conserved (a stated look, UNCALIBRATED)

lightning.flash_light: unshadowed (the default; -lightning-shadows=on is the shadowed light)
lightning.exposure: each frame draws the flash's mean power over its own exposure (window_power): a shutter that misses a stroke shows no bolt

not_claimed: drops are advected by the wind at the camera, not their own
splashes only on the ground plane under the camera (the scene datum)
the cell does not grow or decay; no mammatus, wall cloud or hail
whether the volumetric cloud reads Extinction per metre is a Windows measurement
lightning: the leader drawn as a smooth descent; the channel inside the cloud as glow
thunder is heard only in the interactive window; the render records its schedule

height_fog.directional_inscattering_basis: the pow lobe whose mean cosine (n+1)/(n+2) is the volumetric fog's g, clamped (FlightSimWorldPure::FogDirectionalExponentForG)

dust_haze.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every DUST_ROWS value, RH_GAMMA, the inversion height and the second fog density are set by probe render on the render machine (docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md ## dust-humidity-haze; core/scene/dust_haze.py is the table)
dust_haze.row_basis: none of the card's words select dust or haze
dust_haze.mie_basis: kept: no visibility_km on the card, or the -aerosol= probe set the Mie scale
dust_haze.other_absorption: kept: the none row tints nothing

second_fog.shape: the engine's exponential fog, not a slab: density doubles every 1/(falloff x 0.1) m below the inversion and halves as fast above it

dust_haze.labels: values only: nothing moves a pixel; the second layer's camera-to-aircraft transmittance is a cloud_path row each frame, flagged (cloud_occludes_aircraft) under the occlusion threshold

clouds.labels: volumetric clouds write no depth or stencil: the mask, class and depth never see them. Clouds stay where the card puts them; each frame records the camera-to-aircraft path through every layer, its estimated transmittance and cloud_occludes_aircraft (frames[]); the mask is not edited

march.path_basis: CloudConstrainedGpu (GRHIDeviceIsIntegrated, or a feature level below SM6): the constrained row is ef361bd6's march
march.banding_basis: round 1 marched 192 view samples over up to 80 km (400 m steps through 0.05/m cloud) and 10 unjittered quadratic shadow samples over 15 km: contour banding and unlit cloud. The view march is blue-noise jittered by the engine (VolumetricCloud.usf) and averaged by the still's captures ONLY once the commandlet has loaded and built the blue-noise textures before the first capture (clouds round 6: render_settings.beauty_path.blue_noise; a commandlet otherwise gets BlueNoise.cpp's constant dummy, the altitude-slice strata of round 3); the shadow march spans the layer (CloudShadowTracingKm)
march.cloud_tiers_basis: round 52: the engine's shadow march is unjittered (ShadowJitterNorm 0.5) and each quadratic segment is opaque at cloud extinction, so the sun's light came in on/off iso-altitude tiers; M_FlightSimCloudLayers dithers and softens a shadow sample over its segment's footprint (ShadowFootprintKm = 2 sqrt(shadow km) / shadow samples, per layer), and the plane weather field's vertical walls lean and bulge with height (SideBulge); no sample added. -look-cloud-tiers=off sets both 0: round 51's clouds
march.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine

deck_shadow.applied: not a deck preset with a drawn layer of min_cover: the scene's switch stands
deck_shadow.basis: the law of world_beauty.deck_shadows_beam -- under an overcast the ground gets the deck's diffuse transmission, not the clear-sky beam (round 4's #10: a 10 deg red beam on the Flint Hills); beauty only; UNCALIBRATED

clouds.coverage_law: cloud_layers.hlsl (round 10: a rounded, domain-warped 2D weather field, flat bases, domed tops, a smoother far field) cuts the shape noise at its (1 - cover) quantile: FBM_MEAN 0.55 + FBM_SIGMA 0.069 x probit(1 - cover) (the noise's own moments, world_beauty.CLOUD_FBM_*), started early by half the erosion's share of the soft edge, so the drawn share of sky at full profile is the stated cover
clouds.drawn: no cloud on the engine material to redraw

aircraft_clearance.law: the law of world_beauty.aircraft_clear_layer, a deck whose slab widened by clearance_m holds the aircraft moves clear of it with its thickness kept (a rain or storm deck above, others to the nearer side); UNCALIBRATED

distant_clouds.engine_content: UE 5.7 still ships /Engine/EngineSky/BP_Sky_Sphere with M_Sky_Panning_Clouds, M_Sky_Panning_Clouds2(_Inst) and T_Sky_Clouds_M (read in the engine content on 2026-11-10); not used: a sky sphere covers the SkyAtmosphere

volumetric_trace.basis: the distant tracing (world_beauty.distant_tracing_max_km), constrained and the sheet drawn -> min(row, DISTANT_NEAR_FIELD_KM). VolumetricCloud.usf: StepCount = SampleCountMax x saturate(path x InvDistanceToSampleCountMax) (r.VolumetricCloud.DistanceToSampleMaxCount, 15 km), non-decreasing in the path: a shorter trace never adds a sample, only shortens the step; the sheet fades in over FadeKm up to the trace's end

distant_clouds.cover_basis: the storm cell's deck (world_beauty.DISTANT_STORM_SHAPE: the nimbostratus row's default cover)

distant_clouds.sheet_altitude_law: per frame (frames[].distant_sheet_*): at the deck's base with the camera below the slab's middle (bases), at its top above (tops); faded out inside the slab (world_beauty.distant_sheet_altitude_m)

tiles.dehaze_law: soft toe: removal Dehaze x HAZE_RGB (0.010, 0.015, 0.022) x a / (a + k), k = h / (1 - 0.5), white kept white; a dark texel keeps at least half of itself (world_beauty.TILES_HAZE_RGB, TILES_DEHAZE_TOE, UNCALIBRATED)
tiles.grade_basis: Dehaze and Saturation are the tileset's imagery correction (world_beauty.TILES_DEHAZE, TILES_SATURATION, UNCALIBRATED), one value for every weather; the weather's grade is beauty_look's frame grade alone

materials.state: look instances on the mesh's slots (shading only: no world position offset; every class master opaque but the thin canopy, which is applied only without -labels, so the label silhouette is the beauty's)
materials.fallback_rule: a paint / bare-metal slot draws its class master when it compiled on this shader platform, else M_AircraftPaintCoat (no Custom node), else M_AircraftProbeFlat; -aircraft-probe=flat / coat force one (aircraft_look.MASTER_FALLBACK_ORDER)
materials.thin_glass: MI_<slot>_thin (Thin Translucent, Surface ForwardShading) where it exists: beauty without labels

canopy_reflect.lane: swarm/lanes/aircraft_exterior/glass/coastal (tiers 0-1 only: opaque, no translucency, no SSR)

aircraft_look.lights_note: point/spot lights move no geometry; the bulbs are additive (they hide nothing), beauty-only actors the label captures hide

contrail.formation_ramp_basis: round 47: the trail forms over contrail.FormationRampS after FormationDelayS (FormationRamp = FormationRampS / LifetimeS); -contrail-formation-ramp=off is the A/B
contrail.rule: drawn while atmosphere/T-R is below contrail.MaxTemperatureK and position/h-sl-meters above contrail.MinAltitudeM (Schmidt-Appleman threshold, no humidity modelled); wingtip vapour from the humidity test (aircraft_look.condensation), or while accelerations/Nz exceeds vapour.MinNz when the humidity is unavailable; vapour_frames counts only the frames these wingtip vapour trails drew (the humidity-gated tip ribbons' frames are in aircraft_look.condensation.per_frame)
contrail.in_cloud: a contrail's opacity x (1 - cover) of every cloud layer the aircraft is inside (base..top above the ground datum); contrail_in_cloud_frames counts them
contrail.label_convention: a trail is a translucent medium like the clouds and rain the label captures already omit: where it crosses in front of the aircraft the mask still says aircraft

heat_haze.switch: -heat-haze=on (off by default; never on in a measured shot)

condensation.formula: T_l = T (p_l/p)^0.2857; dq = q_v(RH,T,p) - q_sat(T_l,p_l); opacity = clamp(OpacityPerGkg x (q_v - q_sat(T_l + OnsetCoolingK, p_l))), 0 below VisibleMinGkg. tip: Gamma = Nz W/(rho V b pi/4), dp = 0.87 rho Gamma^2/(4 pi^2 rc^2), rc = CoreRadiusSpanFraction b; sheet: CL = Nz W/(qbar S), Cp_min = -(SheetCpMinAtZeroLift + CpMinPerCL CL), p_l = p(1 + 0.7 M^2 Cp_min); lex: alpha > LexAlphaOnsetDeg, Cp = -LexCpPerDeg (alpha - onset); cone: ConeMachMin <= M <= ConeMachMax, T_l/T = (1+0.2M^2)/(1+0.2 ConeLocalMach^2), p_l/p = (T_l/T)^3.5, ending at the recompression shock. Python twin core/scene/condensation.py
condensation.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: every constant, the 0.87 Lamb-Oseen factor and the compressible Cp form are engineering approximations; set by probe render on the render machine (a humid low pass at M 0.95; a 5 g pull-up in the forest rain scene)
condensation.label_convention: translucent media: not in mask, class or depth (trail convention)
condensation.humidity: unavailable: the card states no dew point -- the Nz fallback (vapour.MinNz) runs

sites.placement: tips at the +/-Y vertex extremes; the cone collar at the X slice of largest (Y span x Z span), radius half that slice's Y span, the shock ConeLengthBodyFraction x body length aft; the sheet over the wing chord measured in span bands (the cluster of largest X extent), at the 90th-percentile Z; the LEX at the look config's offsets

afterburner.rule: glow = saturate((thrust/max - mil/max) / (1 - mil/max)) x GlowGain, static sea-level ratings from the engine file; additive plume, hides nothing

constants.source: aircraft_look.constants.wet (the look manifest; every other wet constant is a master scalar default: scripts/aircraft_wet_layer.py WET_DEFAULTS)

wet.rule: target = saturate(rain_rate_mmh / WetSaturationMmh); wetting immediate, drying exp(-dt / WetDryTauS) on simulation/sim-time-sec; regime airflow at or above BeadingMaxKts (rivulets aft along object -X), else gravity (runs along world -Z, beads on glass)
wet.label_convention: shading only on the beauty look MIDs: no world position offset, every master opaque (the canopy glass included), so silhouette, class, mask and depth are the dry airframe's
wet.calibration: UNCALIBRATED: set by probe render on the render machine

scene.gi_reflections: Lumen GI + Lumen reflections (capture post-process override)
scene.exposure: manual, AutoExposureBias 9.6; closed 1.81 stops by the beauty meter's highlight guard (look_applied.storm_exposure.highlight_guard)
scene.terrain_material: true-colour satellite imagery drape (see imagery_* fields; acquisition-date and resolution limits in VALIDITY.md)
scene.imagery_attribution: Sentinel-2 cloudless - https://s2maps.eu by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016 & 2017)
scene.physics_ground: flat slab at spec terrain_elevation; visual terrain carries no collision

pixel_moving_effects.name: motion_blur
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: bound: MotionBlurMax percent of the width, by construction; not measured
pixel_moving_effects.source: beauty capture: MotionBlur show flag and MotionBlurAmount/MotionBlurMax (look-dev lens)

pixel_moving_effects.name: depth_of_field
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: not measured: zero at the focal plane (the aircraft, focused per frame), growing off it; the class and depth labels of defocused terrain spread
pixel_moving_effects.source: beauty capture: DepthOfField show flag and DepthOfFieldFocalDistance > 0 (look-dev per-frame focus)

pixel_moving_effects.name: heat_haze
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: bound: heat_haze.hlsl's peak offset x width x 0.00023 / tan(hFOV/2) (UE 5.7.4 DistortionCommon.ush), along the diagonal, by construction; not measured

pixel_moving_effects.name: path_tracer_filter
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: not measured: the path tracer's pixel filter (r.PathTracing.FilterWidth) and the Nanite fallback mesh it traces (render_settings.beauty_path.path_tracer.labels_note)

pixel_moving_effects.name: chromatic_aberration
pixel_moving_effects.source: beauty capture: SceneColorFringe show flag and SceneFringeIntensity

pixel_moving_effects.name: lens_drops
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: bound: M_LensDrops samples the scene mirrored within an 1/18-screen cell, at most 0.6/18 of the viewport per axis, by construction; not measured
pixel_moving_effects.source: beauty capture: M_LensDrops in WeightedBlendables (rain look, a camera with no weather rain)

pixel_moving_effects.name: windshield_rain
pixel_moving_effects.displacement_basis: bound: windshield.hlsl refracts by at most 0.4 / cells of the height (Glass.w), by construction; not measured
pixel_moving_effects.source: beauty capture: M_WindshieldRain in WeightedBlendables (storm weather, cockpit/shoulder camera)

beauty_samples.shutter_basis: no engine motion blur on the beauty capture

beauty_only_actors.name: Actor_3
beauty_only_actors.hidden_by: Cloud show flag off on every label capture

cloud_occlusion.basis: not modelled: a drawn cloud is outside the slab model (the storm cell, another material's cloud, -beauty-clouds=engine, or the beauty cloud material missing); cover not measured: no label mask to measure inside (-labels not given)
cloud_occlusion.method: max over frames of 1 - prod(layer transmittance) along the camera-to-aircraft-origin ray (FlightSimWorldPure::Occlusion; per frame in look_applied.world_beauty.frames[].cloud_covered_fraction_modelled)
cloud_occlusion.not_modelled: rain, contrails, wingtip vapour and the afterburner plume (beauty-only translucent media) are not in this fraction; experiments/look_label_check.py measures the covered fraction from the pixels
cloud_occlusion.measured_cover: no label mask to measure inside (-labels not given)

hero_lighting.direction: the sun's direction is the scenario's time of day, date and heading (core/scene/hero_lighting.py solves them per shot); nothing here adds or moves a light

sun.source_angle_basis: the true solar disc (physics) plus an UNCALIBRATED soft angle
sun.light_shaft_occlusion_basis: off: screen-space, so it re-tones the horizon sky as the bank moves the terrain on screen (Gate 6 beauty breathing); overrides the world lane's sun-shafts row; shafts come from the volumetric fog's and the atmosphere's world-space shadows

aureole.owner: world lane (FlightSimClouds.cpp); read back, not set

sky_light.capture: captured once by the commandlet before the first frame (and per frame when the sun animates)
sky_light.lower_hemisphere_basis: unchanged: no -hero-lighting= sidecar named a ground

probes.source: -flags or FLIGHTSIM_RENDER_SWITCHES (beauty only; defaults are the planned render)
probes.sky_cloud_ao_basis: auto: off when the one sky capture is taken at the aircraft with the clouds in it (the cube already holds the deck overhead; the cloud AO would count it twice and black out an airframe under an overcast); on otherwise (lane A, 2026-11-11)

reflections.route: software fallback: ray tracing is not enabled in this process; screen traces then the surface cache

hero_lighting.labels: beauty only: label captures read stencil, depth, GBuffer and velocity, which lighting does not change, and ExcludeFromLabel turns light shafts and contact shadows off on them
hero_lighting.calibration: UNCALIBRATED except the solar disc and the unit scales: each value is set by the probe named in docs/visual/PROBE_LOG.md "## hero-lighting"

environment.downburst_delivery: position-coupled: field evaluated at the aircraft's actual position each step (the nominal-track label is obsolete for this clip)
